fidelityBoundary: Terminal Velocity automation/design scaffold; not an EV Classic fidelity claim without original runtime, decoded Classic resources, or manual/docs confirmation.

levo_merchant_first_hop.purpose: Merchant first-hop loop: buy a Levo commodity lot, accept a safe cargo job, jump, land, and complete delivery.

trade_route_margin_choice_loop.purpose: Trade-route margin-choice loop: at Sol, compare a profitable Food return leg against an unprofitable Equipment candidate, carry only the positive-margin lot to Levo, and retain explicit pending-Classic market-selection boundaries.

cargo_expansion_trade_loop.purpose: Cargo-expansion trade loop: hit the starting hold limit on a third Sol Food lot, buy a cargo pod at Earth, carry the expanded three-lot load to Levo, and verify profit while preserving pending-Classic source boundaries.
